name: Context Compressor
description: Automatic RTK-style compression of verbose tool output + deterministic pre-compaction snapshot. By Rin.

minLines.description: Only compress tool output with at least this many lines.

teeDir.description: Workspace-relative output directory, or absolute path inside each selected workspace; supports {agentId}.

denyTools.description: Tool names to never compress (e.g. tools whose output must stay verbatim).

retentionDays.description: Prune owned output/snapshot files during activity, at most once per minute. 0 keeps indefinitely.

workspaceByAgent.description: Explicit agent allowlist mapping IDs to absolute workspace paths; unlisted agents are skipped even with runtime workspace context.

allowTools.description: Only these tool names may be compressed. Defaults to shell/process tools; use [] to disable output compression. Do not opt research, browser, memory, or inter-agent handoff tools into lossy compression. Valid JSON and structuredContent are preserved.
